entities.name: Sylvene
entities.description: A wizard from Ravnica who came to the Sword Coast decades ago, fell in love, built a demiplane refuge, and later returned to Ravnica with her infant son.

entities.name: Sylvene's grandson
entities.description: Sylvene's careless grandson who seeks relics of her power in the Realms, harming others along the way.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Sylvene came from and returned to.

entities.name: Sword Coast
entities.description: The region of Faerun where Sylvene lived for a time.

entities.name: Waterdeep
entities.description: A city Sylvene explored on the Sword Coast.

entities.name: Sylvene's demiplane
entities.description: A refuge Sylvene created for her family.

events.summary: Decades ago Sylvene comes from Ravnica to the Sword Coast, falls in love, and builds a demiplane refuge.
events.quote: She built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her own creation

events.summary: Sylvene returns to Ravnica with her infant son and never comes back.
events.quote: she went home to Ravnica with her infant son and never returned

events.summary: Her grandson now seeks her relics in the Realms and harms others along the way.
events.quote: Now her grandson seeks to recover relics of her power by exploring Sylvene's history in the Realms
